name: Kedra AI Index
summary: Shopify app that checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI assistants recommend your store, ranks fixes, and publishes llms.txt and agents.md files.
best_for: Shopify store owners who want to see whether AI assistants recommend their products and want llms.txt and agents.md files kept up to date from the catalog
skip_if: you do not sell on Shopify, you want independent documentation before you install, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: It is a young app, listed since April 2026, and we found no documentation for it outside the Shopify listing. It works only on Shopify, and the visibility results come from the vendor's own tests, which we could not check.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter is $10 a month or $100 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-11 on the Shopify App Store listing, US dollars) Kedra has a Free plan and three paid plans. Free covers an AI visibility check on 5 AI engines, 3 AI fixes drafted and applied for you, llms.txt and agents.md files, and visits from ChatGPT and other AI assistants for the last 30 days. Starter costs $10 a month or $100 a year and adds a weekly visibility check, 15 AI fixes a month and 90 days of AI traffic and sales analytics. Grow costs $25 a month or $216 a year and adds daily tracking in 1 market, 12 buyer questions on ChatGPT and Gemini, 40 AI fixes a month with a fix autopilot, and 5 AI blog posts a month. Pro costs $79 a month or $708 a year and adds tracking in 3 markets, 30 buyer questions, unlimited AI fixes and 15 blog posts a month. The listing shows a 10-day free trial on Starter and Grow. Charges run through your Shopify bill, and we did not open the install screen, so any tax or currency conversion is not known. An earlier reading on 18 October 2026 also showed a Scale plan at $199 a month; it is not on the listing now.
